facts.text: The image is a composite character reference sheet arranged in three tiers: one large hero scene at top, three full-body turnaround views across the middle, and four close-up detail panels across the bottom.
Visible panel labels read 'HERO', 'FRONT', 'SIDE PROFILE', 'BACK', 'FACE', 'JACKET COLLAR', 'HANDS', and 'BOOTS'.
The central figure is an adult with short shaved sides and longer hair gathered into a small topknot; a scar runs through the viewer-left eyebrow.
The figure wears a black high-collared tactical jacket with strap and metal buckle detail, a black shirt, black cargo trousers, and black lace-up combat boots.
In the hero panel, the figure stands upright with arms at the sides and head turned toward the viewer's left on a wet industrial walkway or rooftop at night.
The hero setting includes dark metal railings on both sides, rain streaks, reflective wet ground, distant city lights, and lit windows in a dark building.
The middle panels show front, side-profile, and back full-body views against a plain dark gray backdrop, with the figure standing and arms at the sides.
The bottom close-ups show the face, the jacket collar with buckle hardware, grimy hands with visible knuckles, and worn black lace-up boots.
Lighting is low-key and cinematic: cool blue-gray night ambience with warm amber practical lights in the hero panel, and soft directional light on the neutral studio panels.
The color palette is dominated by black and charcoal, with cool blue-gray shadows and warm amber highlights.

card.summary: A cinematic photorealistic character reference sheet for a tactical-dressed figure, featuring a rainy night 'HERO' shot, front/side/back turnaround views, and close-up details of face, jacket collar, hands, and boots.
